source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 看下半年经济工作着力点
topics.official_english: Economic focus points for the second half of the year under review
topics.why_hot: It signals the direction of economic policy for the rest of the year, a key concern for markets and households.
topics.share_angle: Explain policy terms simply and connect the economic agenda to everyday spending and jobs.

topics.chinese_topic: 新一轮油价调整今晚开启
topics.official_english: New round of fuel price adjustment begins tonight
topics.why_hot: Fuel prices affect daily costs for drivers and the logistics chain, so changes are widely noticed.
topics.share_angle: Walk through how China prices fuel and what the adjustment means for commuters and businesses.

topics.official_english: New batch of regulations takes effect in August
topics.why_hot: New rules affect many areas of daily life, and people quickly want to know what is changing.
topics.share_angle: Summarize the general areas of the new rules without speculating on unlisted details.

topics.chinese_topic: 开学三件套卖不动了？有老板愁坏
topics.official_english: Back-to-school 'three-piece set' sales slump worries shop owners
topics.why_hot: Back-to-school shopping is a seasonal test of consumer demand and small retail performance.
topics.share_angle: Discuss changing back-to-school habits and what weak sales say about consumer behavior.

topics.chinese_topic: 1.55升“哑铃矿泉水”火了 单瓶8元
topics.official_english: 1.55-liter 'dumbbell water' becomes a hit at 8 yuan per bottle
topics.why_hot: The unusual bottle design and relatively high price quickly triggered online debates about product marketing.
topics.share_angle: Use the viral bottle as a case study in novelty packaging, pricing, and social media exposure.

topics.chinese_topic: 长期炎症是癌症的“帮凶”
topics.official_english: Chronic inflammation seen as a 'helper' of cancer
topics.why_hot: Cancer prevention is a top health concern, and the link with long-term inflammation is easy to grasp.
topics.share_angle: Break down the science of acute versus chronic inflammation and why persistent inflammation matters.

topics.chinese_topic: 长鑫科技市值突破4万亿
topics.official_english: Changxin Technology market value exceeds 4 trillion yuan
topics.why_hot: A chip company reaching a 4-trillion-yuan market value is a milestone for China's semiconductor sector.
topics.share_angle: Give context on Changxin Technology's role in memory chips and why the milestone matters.

topics.official_english: South Korean stocks hit circuit breaker on sharp gains
topics.why_hot: An upside circuit breaker is rare and points to unusually strong market sentiment.
topics.share_angle: Explain how trading halts work and why a surge-driven halt is different from a decline-driven one.
